hebrewText: וְ/אַחַ֤ר הַ/דֶּ֨לֶת֙ וְ/הַ/מְּזוּזָ֔ה שַׂ֖מְתְּ זִכְרוֹנֵ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י מֵ/אִתִּ֞/י גִּלִּ֣ית וַֽ/תַּעֲלִ֗י הִרְחַ֤בְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵ/ךְ֙ וַ/תִּכְרָת לָ֣/ךְ מֵ/הֶ֔ם אָהַ֥בְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבָ֖/ם יָ֥ד חָזִֽית

tokens.bdb: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.

tokens.bdb: something swinging, i.e. the valve of adoor
to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal
tokens.kjv: [phrase] advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, [idiom] plainly, publish, remove, reveal, [idiom] shamelessly, shew, [idiom] surely, tell, uncover.

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be an en-(make) large(-ing), make room, make (open) wide.

tokens.bdb: a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse
to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
tokens.kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.
